notes.note: Bounded Apps mutation-error review after conversation-main integration: create/update/delete failure rendering now calls describeStationFailure instead of exposing Error.message. SDK mutation ownership, owner permissions, draft retention, retry, dirty navigation, and success cleanup are unchanged. The mounted owner uses real SDK requests, refuses create/update/delete with a private diagnostic, asserts safe copy and preserved drafts/records, and retries successfully. Injecting both old production renderers caused three intended failures; byte-identical restoration returned nine tests to green. Existing documented Apps workflow remains accurate; this note does not establish native, physical-device, provider, or release qualification.
